title:
Oscar themed staff celebration event 👥

We held our first annual staff celebration on 29.5.25 across Blue Pits, Newbarn Ltd and Freehold Cottage 

We celebrated staffs achievements, the tenants performed a show, we learnt about the history of the organisations and a murder mystery event! 

Our categories were:
-longstanding staff member 
- best Support worker voted by the tenants
- best staff voted by colleagues 
- best administrator 
-best maintenance worker 

It was hugely successful and we can’t wait for next year 

#bluepitshousingaction #socialcare
#staffcelebration #awards
